title: KiCad Design Block Spec
description: Structured intermediate representation of a KiCad design block, produced by Claude from a screenshot or description and consumed by the kicad-sch-api MCP server to generate a .kicad_sch file.

name.description: Block identifier in snake_case. Becomes the .kicad_sch filename.

description.description: One-line summary, shown in the design block library browser.

target_lib_path.description: Filesystem path (absolute or product-relative) to the design block library directory. The generated .kicad_sch is written to <target_lib_path>/<n>.kicad_sch.

schematic_size.description: Page size for the design block. A4 is appropriate for almost all blocks.

ports.description: External connection points of the block. Become hierarchical labels in the .kicad_sch and connection points when the block is instantiated.

name.description: Port name. Common conventions: VIN, VOUT_3V3, GND, SDA, SCL, /RESET.

side.description: Which side of the block this port appears on. Inputs typically left, outputs right, ground bottom, supplies top.

type.description: Electrical type, used by ERC to flag mismatches when the block is instantiated.

components.description: Every electrical component in the block.

ref.description: Reference designator, e.g. R1, C3, U1. Must be unique within the block.

lib_id.description: KiCad symbol library identifier in the form <library>:<symbol>, e.g. Device:R, Regulator_Linear:AMS1117-3.3. Must resolve in the user's KiCad symbol library setup.

value.description: Schematic value. For passives: '10k', '100nF'. For ICs: typically the part name, e.g. 'AMS1117-3.3'.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number. Validated against approved_parts.csv at pre-flight. Omit only for power flags / mechanical-only symbols.

footprint.description: KiCad footprint identifier in the form <library>:<footprint>, e.g. Resistor_SMD:R_0603_1608Metric.

position.description: Schematic [x, y] position in mm. KiCad's grid is typically 2.54 mm; positions should be multiples of 1.27 mm at minimum.

power_symbols.description: Explicit power flags / supply symbols. Use for global rails (GND, +5V, +3V3) that should not appear as ports.

net.description: Power net name, e.g. 'GND', '+3V3', '+5V', 'VBUS'. Must match a KiCad power symbol in the user's libraries.

connections.description: Wire-level netlist. Each connection links two endpoints; both must reference either a component pin or a declared port.

waypoints.description: Optional intermediate [x, y] points if the wire needs explicit routing. Omit for a direct connection.

labels.description: Net labels at specific positions. Use to name internal nets that aren't ports.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the block — design rationale, gotchas, references. Rendered as a text frame on the schematic.

pin.description: Pin number or name as it appears in the symbol.

port.description: Name of a port declared in the spec's `ports` array.

power.description: Name of a power symbol's net (must exist in `power_symbols`).
